Shift Scheduler

Build a rotating shift schedule: set days-on / days-off, the start date and shift pattern to get a dated roster with on/off days.

Set the rotation to generate the schedule.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick the rotation start date.
  2. Enter days on and days off (e.g. 4 on / 4 off).
  3. Choose day, night or alternating shifts, and how many days to show.
  4. Read the dated roster with every on/off day and shift labelled.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What patterns does it support?

Any N-days-on / M-days-off rotation — 4-on/4-off, 5-on/2-off, 2-on/2-off — over any date range up to 120 days.

What are the shift types?

Day shifts, night shifts, or alternating day/night for each working day.

Does the rotation continue across months?

Yes — the on/off cycle runs continuously from the start date regardless of month or year boundaries.
